#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

inline int add(int a, int b) {
    a += b;
    if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
    return a;
}

inline long long mul(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = a * b;
    if (res >= MOD) res %= MOD;
    return res;
}

namespace matrix {
    template<int N, int M>
    class Matrix {
    public:
        int data[N][M];

        void clear() {
            memset(data, 0, sizeof(data));
        }

        void identity() {
            clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < min(N, M); ++i) data[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix<M, N> transpose() const {
            Matrix<M, N> res;
            for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) res.data[i][j] = data[j][i];
            return res;
        }

        const int* operator[](int idx) const { return data[idx]; }
        int* operator[](int idx) { return data[idx]; }

        Matrix<N, M> operator+(const Matrix<N, M>& other) const {
            Matrix<N, M> res;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) res.data[i][j] = add(data[i][j], other.data[i][j]);
            return res;
        }

        Matrix<N, M> operator*(int scalar) const {
            Matrix<N, M> res = *this;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) res.data[i][j] = (int)mul(res.data[i][j], scalar);
            return res;
        }

        template<int X>
        friend Matrix<N, M> multiply(const Matrix<N, X>& a, const Matrix<X, M>& b) {
            Matrix<N, M> res;
            res.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < X; ++j) {
                    if (a.data[i][j]) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < M; ++k)
                            res.data[i][k] = add(res.data[i][k], (int)mul(a.data[i][j], b.data[j][k]));
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    };
}

using namespace matrix;
using ll = long long;

ll n;
int K;
vector<int> digits;
Matrix<35, 35> base[65][35], prefix[65][35], suffix[65][35], result;

int main() {
    scanf("%lld%d", &n, &K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        base[0][i].identity();
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) base[0][i].data[i][j] = 1;
    }

    ll block_size = K;
    for (int level = 1; block_size <= n; ++level, block_size *= K) {
        suffix[level - 1][K - 1] = base[level - 1][K - 1];
        for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; --j)
            suffix[level - 1][j] = multiply(base[level - 1][j], suffix[level - 1][j + 1]);

        prefix[level - 1][0] = base[level - 1][0];
        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
            prefix[level - 1][j] = multiply(prefix[level - 1][j - 1], base[level - 1][j]);

        base[level][0] = suffix[level - 1][0];
        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
            base[level][j] = multiply(suffix[level - 1][j], prefix[level - 1][j - 1]);
    }

    while (n > 0) {
        digits.push_back(n % K);
        n /= K;
    }

    int carry = 0;
    result.identity();
    for (int i = (int)digits.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; ++j)
            result = multiply(result, base[i][(j + carry) % K]);
        carry = (carry + digits[i]) % K;
    }

    int answer = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i)
        answer = add(answer, result.data[i][K]);
    printf("%d\n", answer);
    return 0;
}
